newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares slip, expected to bottom out.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares slip, expected to bottom out.

text.p: 1310 GMT -- Austrian shares continue slide, but close above Thursday's lows, as investors nervously eye U.S data due out later in the day for fresh clues on direction of U.S. rates.
Traders say further declines unlikely, noting strong support at 1,160 points in ATX.
* ATX index down 7.67 points, or 0.65 percent, at 1,168.89 after trading between 1,157.89 and 1,176.14 points.

* Leading ATX decliner beverage group BBAG, down 4.17 percent at year-low of 690 ATS, adding to Wednesday's 3.1 percent decline after rejecting takeover attempt by South African Breweries earlier this week.
* In continuous trade, but not included in the ATX, water treatment company BWT extends its bull run, adding another 8.73 percent to close at new year-high of 1,707 ATS.
* April ATX future down seven points at 1,163 on turnover of 1,598 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
